help: usage: fleet-switchboard orders [-h] [--cos] {list,add,remove} ... The owner's standing orders live in the charter issue's `## Standing orders` section on GitHub, one per bullet: `- <text> (ordered by <name>, <YYYY-MM- DD>)`. The switchboard re-supplies them to every agent of the charter at its start, after each compaction and when they change, and the policy judge reads them at every tool call. `list` is open to anyone. `add` and `remove` are for the chief-of-staff only (you are identified by your pane); they edit only that section of the issue body. `--cos` prints the Chief of Staff's OWN standing orders: one local markdown file the owner edits (nothing here writes it). positional arguments: {list,add,remove} list The charter's standing orders, numbered add Chief of Staff only: record one standing order the owner gave remove Chief of Staff only: remove one order the owner revoked options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --cos PR 18: print the Chief of Staff's own standing orders file and its path (read-only: the owner edits that file in an editor; there is no write command)
